//: What a contract stack and the suite agree on — the trust configuration
and who exists — so neither guesses. Read by contract_stack.py (the
Python stack) and by contract/src/support/env.ts; a .NET stack reads the
clientIds are the app clients the services verify a token's client_id
(Cognito) or aud (Google) against. They are local names, not real pool
clients; their only property that matters is that they are DISJOINT,
because that disjointness is the audience check the suite exercises.
accounts maps every person seeds/dev.json names to the subject the
stack's user directory answers for them — the `sub` the suite signs into
a token. Addresses end in .test (RFC 2606): nobody's mailbox.
